vocab-allergist:example-1.text: My allergist recommended a skin test for pollen allergies.

vocab-allergist:example-2.text: You should see an allergist if your rash keeps coming back.

vocab-allergist:example-3.text: The allergist explained which foods the child should avoid.
vocab-allergist:example-3.translation: アレルギー専門医は、その子が避けるべき食べ物を説明した。

vocab-antitoxin:example-1.text: Doctors gave the patient an antitoxin after the dangerous infection was confirmed.

vocab-antitoxin:recall.text: 病院の場面: The doctor injected an ___ to counter the poison in the patient's blood.

vocab-attain:example-1.text: She studied daily to attain a high level of English.

vocab-bombard:example-1.text: The company bombarded customers with emails during the holiday sale.

vocab-fragile:example-1.text: Please be careful with this box because the glasses are fragile.
